phase: Authority topology Phase E hardening and scale

scenario.description: Large room-family baseline with retention-cap enforcement and promotion-path verification.

workload.promotion_probe_child: latest child id in retained window

policy_tuning_guidance: Start with NODALMERGE_LINEAGE_CHILDREN_INDEX_MAX between 64 and 256 for hot parents, then tune using nodalmerge_lineage_children_index_size by parent_room_id.
For bursty promotion traffic, tune NODALMERGE_TOPOLOGY_PROMOTION_MAX_QUEUE before increasing inflight to preserve fair FIFO behavior and bounded memory.
Keep promotion inflight low (4-8) unless CPU and storage p95 headroom is verified in production-like traces.
